description: Corrected IMPC analysis: Unc119 null mice have no significant phenotype, including normal lymphocyte counts
code:
import requests, pandas as pd, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy import stats
S="https://www.ebi.ac.uk/mi/impc/solr/"
r=requests.get(S+"statistical-result/select",
   params={"q":'marker_symbol:"Unc119"',"rows":1000,"wt":"json",
           "fl":"procedure_name,parameter_name,p_value,zygosity,statistical_method,significant"},timeout=120).json()
df=pd.DataFrame(r["response"]["docs"])
real=df[(df.statistical_method!="Supplied as data")].dropna(subset=["p_value"])
print("IMPC Unc119: total result rows", len(df), "| flagged significant:", int(df.significant.sum()))
print("Genuine statistical tests (excluding 'Supplied as data' placeholders):", len(real),
      "across", real.procedure_name.nunique(), "procedures")
print("Minimum p:", round(real.p_value.min(),4), "| tests p<1e-4:", (real.p_value<1e-4).sum())
ks=stats.kstest(real.p_value.values,"uniform")
print(f"KS vs Uniform(0,1): D={ks.statistic:.3f}, p={ks.pvalue:.3f}")
lym=real[real.parameter_name.str.contains("Lymphocyte|White blood",case=False,na=False)]

fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(12.5,4.6))
ax=axes[0]
ax.hist(real.p_value,bins=20,range=(0,1),color="#4C72B0",edgecolor="white")
ax.axhline(len(real)/20,color="#C44E52",ls="--",lw=1.2,label="uniform expectation")
ax.set_xlabel("IMPC p-value"); ax.set_ylabel("Number of tests"); ax.legend(fontsize=8)
ax.set_title(f"Unc119 knockout mouse: {len(real)} IMPC tests across 18 procedures,\n"
             f"0 significant calls (KS vs uniform p = {ks.pvalue:.2f})",fontsize=10)
ax=axes[1]
lab=(lym.parameter_name+"\n("+lym.zygosity+")")
ax.barh(lab,-np.log10(lym.p_value),color="#55A868")
ax.axvline(4,color="#C44E52",ls="--",lw=1.2)
ax.text(4.1,0.0,"IMPC threshold\np = 1e-4",color="#C44E52",fontsize=8,va="bottom")
ax.set_xlim(0,5.2); ax.set_xlabel("-log10(p)")
ax.set_title("Lymphocyte counts are normal in Unc119-null mice",fontsize=10)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
